chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the marvel of the creation of the universe.
The greatness of Allah and the creation of the Universe.
ai.seo_question: What is the theme of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the creation of the universe in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This title, 'On the Wonders of the Craftsmanship of the Universe,' introduces a sermon where Imam Ali (AS) employs rational observation of nature to establish the existence of a Creator, a method deeply valued in Shia kalam (theology). It underscores the concept of 'ayah' (sign), inviting believers to reflect on the order and complexity of creation as direct evidence of divine unity and power.

en.sayed-ali-raza: The greatness of Allāh and the creation of the Universe
